using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics.Metrics;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Functions.Tests;

public class KernelFunctionFromPromptTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void CaptureUsageDetails_LogsWarning_WhenTokenCountsMissing()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>>();
        var function = new KernelFunctionFromPrompt("test", logger.Object);
        var modelId = "gpt-4";

        // Enable metrics to pass the early return check
        var originalEnabledPrompt = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePromptEnabled;
        var originalEnabledCompletion = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled;
        try
        {
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePromptEnabled = true;
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled = true;

            // Act
            function.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId, null, logger.Object);

            // Assert
            logger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning(
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Unable to get token details from model result."))),
                Times.Once);
        }
        finally
        {
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePromptEnabled = originalEnabledPrompt;
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled = originalEnabledCompletion;
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CaptureUsageDetails_LogsWarning_WhenUsageDetailsNull()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>>();
        var function = new KernelFunctionFromPrompt("test", logger.Object);
        var modelId = "gpt-4";

        // Enable metrics to pass the early return check
        var originalEnabledPrompt = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePromptEnabled;
        var originalEnabledCompletion = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled;
        try
        {
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePromptEnabled = true;
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled = true;

            // Act
            function.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId, metadata: null, logger.Object);

            // Assert - hits the else branch when usageDetails.InputTokenCount/OutputTokenCount are missing
            logger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning(
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Unable to get token details from model result."))),
                Times.Once);
        }
        finally
        {
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePromptEnabled = originalEnabledPrompt;
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled = originalEnabledCompletion;
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CaptureUsageDetails_DoesNotLogWarning_WhenTokenCountsPresent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>>();
        var function = new KernelFunctionFromPrompt("test", logger.Object);
        var modelId = "gpt-4";
        var usageDetails = new StreamingTokenUsageReport(inputTokenCount: 100, outputTokenCount: 50);

        // Enable metrics to pass the early return check
        var originalEnabledPrompt = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePromptEnabled;
        var originalEnabledCompletion = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled;
        try
        {
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePromptEnabled = true;
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled = true;

            // Act
            function.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId, new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["usage"] = usageDetails }, logger.Object);

            // Assert - should take the if branch, no warning logged
            logger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning(
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<string>()),
                Times.Never);
        }
        finally
        {
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePromptEnabled = originalEnabledPrompt;
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled = originalEnabledCompletion;
        }
    }
}

        // Enable metrics

        KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled = true;

            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletionEnabled = originalCompletionEnabled;
